vault.title: Drive
vault.signed_out: Encrypted storage for your files. Sign in to start.
vault.ready: Signed in. This device has the key to your Drive.
vault.ready_desktop: Connected. This computer has the key to your Drive.
vault.needs_key: Signed in. This device still needs the key from another device.
vault.pending: Signed in. Another of your devices must approve this one.
vault.sign_out: Sign out of Drive on this device
vault.sign_out_title: Sign out of Drive on this device?
vault.sign_out_body: This device forgets the key to your Drive, and uploads that have not finished stop. To use Drive here again, sign in and get the key from another device, the key copy or the recovery phrase.
vault.error_not_invited: Drive is in testing and this account is not on the list yet.
vault.error_generic: Sign-in did not work. Try again.
vault.error_failed: That did not work. Try again.
vault.tester_on: Drive testing is on for this device.
vault.tester_off: Drive testing is off for this device.
vault.get_key: Get the key on this device
vault.show_code: Show a code to another device
vault.get_key_note: Your other devices with Drive have the key. Signing in with Google brings it here by itself once Google is linked.
vault.get_key_note_apple: Your other devices with Drive have the key. Apple devices on the same Apple ID get it through iCloud Keychain, which can take a few minutes.
vault.code_body: On a device that already has your Drive, open Drive account, tap Add a device and scan this code. It works for five minutes.
vault.enter_phrase_body: Type the 24 words in order, with a space between each.
vault.key_received: This device now has the key to your Drive.
vault.ways_back_note: Whoever controls your Google or Apple account can get into your Drive. Turn on two-step verification there.
vault.way_not_linked: Not linked. Link it as a second way back in.
vault.copy_saved_google: Linked. The key copy is in your Google Drive.
vault.copy_saved_icloud: Linked. The key copy is in iCloud Keychain on this device.
vault.copy_failed: Linked. The key copy could not be saved; it is tried again at the next start.
vault.phrase_row_body: 24 words that open your Drive if every other way is lost.
vault.phrase_lock_reason: Unlock to see your Drive recovery phrase
vault.phrase_body: Write these words on paper and keep it somewhere safe. Anyone with them can open your Drive.
vault.phrase_no_lock_title: This device has no screen lock
vault.phrase_no_lock_body: Anyone holding this device can see the phrase. Show it only where nobody else can see the screen.
vault.add_device_body: Scan the code a new device shows to give it the key.
vault.scan_hint: Point the camera at the code on the new device.
vault.scan_no_camera: The camera is not available. Allow camera access in Settings.
vault.grant_title: Give the key to this device?
vault.grant_body: Continue only if the device showing the code is yours and in front of you. It will be able to open every file in your Drive.
vault.key_sent: The key is on its way to the new device.
vault.delete_body: Every file in your Drive is deleted from the server, the key copy is removed and your devices are signed out. This cannot be undone. Sign in once more to confirm.
vault.delete_no_signin: To confirm, sign in with the account linked to this Drive. That sign-in is not available on this device; delete from another of your devices.
vault.delete_plan_body_apple: Deleting the Drive does not cancel the subscription. Cancel it in your App Store account settings first, or it renews and you keep paying.
vault.delete_plan_body_google: Deleting the Drive asks Google Play to stop the renewal. Check it in Google Play under Payments & subscriptions, so you are not charged again.
vault.deleted_google_left: The key copy in your Google Drive could not be removed from this device. Nobody can open it any more. To remove it too, disconnect BIShare in your Google account's connections.
vault.error_identity_in_use: That account already has its own Drive.
vault.error_provider_linked: This Drive already has a sign-in of that kind.
vault.error_key_mismatch: That key belongs to another Drive.
vault.error_phrase_invalid: Those words are not a recovery phrase. Check each word and the order.
vault.error_pair_expired: The code ran out or was used. Show a new code.
vault.error_not_a_code: That is not a Drive code.
vault.intro_body: Files are encrypted on your device before they go up. BIShare cannot read their names or what is in them. 5 GB free.
vault.empty_body: Add files with the upload button, or make a folder.
vault.trash_empty_body: Files you move to trash stay here for 30 days.
vault.delete_for_good_body: This cannot be undone. Folders go with everything in them.
vault.error_bad_name: That name cannot be used. Names cannot be empty or contain “/”.
vault.error_move_into_itself: A folder cannot go into itself.
vault.error_read_only: Your Drive is read-only until the plan is renewed.
vault.error_missing: The file is no longer on this device.
vault.error_open: No app on this device opens this file.
vault.search_none_body: Search looks at names in your whole Drive.
vault.drop_only_in_folders: Open a folder of your Drive to add files there.
vault.empty_view_body: Files you add to your Drive show up here.
vault.share_only_files: Folders cannot be shared this way; share the files inside.
vault.link_body: Anyone with the link can open “{name}” in a browser, with no app or account. The key travels in the link, never to BIShare.
vault.link_until_off: Works until you turn it off
vault.link_email_body: BIShare sends the link to this address. The name of what you share goes in the email.
vault.link_email_bad: That email address does not look right.
vault.link_email_failed: The email could not be sent. Try again later.
vault.link_no_key: This link was made without its key, so it cannot be shown here. You can still turn it off.
vault.link_turn_off_body: Anyone who has it can no longer open it. The files stay in your Drive.
vault.links_empty: No links are open. Share a file or a folder as a link and it shows here.
vault.error_link_limit: 200 links are open. Turn some off first.
vault.error_link_too_many: This folder has too many files for one link (1,999 at most).
vault.error_link_gone: This link is no longer available.
vault.error_too_large_to_share: This file is larger than a transfer link allows.
vault.error_rate_limited: Too many links in a short time. Try again in a while.
vault.info_private: Encrypted on your devices. BIShare sees only sizes and times.
vault.transfers_empty_body: Uploads and downloads of your Drive show here while they run.
vault.storage_note: {files} files in {folders} folders. Content you keep more than once is stored once. Thumbnails count toward the total too.
vault.remove_device_body: It can no longer open or change your Drive, and cannot come back without signing in again. Files it already downloaded stay on it. Sign in once more to confirm.
vault.removed_here: This device was removed from your Drive. Sign in again to use it here.
vault.account_gone: This Drive account no longer exists.
vault.phrase_copied: Copied. It leaves the clipboard in 1 minute; paste it into your password manager now.
vault.phrase_saved: Saved. Keep the file offline or in a password manager, never in a shared folder.
vault.phrase_store_hint: Best kept on paper or in a password manager. Anyone with these words can open your Drive.
vault.phrase_file_body: These 24 words open your BIShare Drive if every other way back in is lost. Anyone who has them can open it too: keep this file offline or in a password manager, and delete other copies.
vault.backup_off_body: Off. When on, photos and videos from this phone go to the “{folder}” folder of your Drive, encrypted on the phone first.

vault.backup_access_denied: BIShare can’t read your photos. Allow access in Settings.

vault.backup_empty_body: Photos and videos you take with this phone show up here.
vault.storage_full: Your Drive is full. New uploads wait until there is room.

vault.pair_letters: No camera? Type these letters instead:
vault.pair_done: This computer is connected to your Drive.

vault.signed_out_desktop: Encrypted storage for your files. Connect with your phone to open it here.

vault.desktop_delete_note: To delete the Drive account, use BIShare on your phone, tablet or Mac.

vault.error_pair_mismatch: This code does not match that browser. Reload the page there and try again.
vault.plans_unavailable: Not on sale in your country
vault.plans_inc_e2e: End-to-end encryption: only your devices hold the key
vault.plans_inc_devices: Your Drive on every device, and on the web

vault.plans_other_store_google: Billed through Google Play. Change or cancel it on your Android device.

vault.plans_legal_google: Payment is charged to your Google Play account when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel it before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in Google Play, under Payments & subscriptions.
vault.plans_err_other_account: This purchase belongs to another Drive account.
vault.plans_err_in_use: This purchase already pays for another Drive.

vault.plans_err_store: The store couldn't complete the purchase.
vault.plans_err_other: The purchase couldn't be checked. Try Restore purchases.
